column3: Close to the Hebrew; The singular verb (“it makes me wise”) is rendered with the plural “Your commandments make me wiser.”
The Hebrew has the singular “your word” and “smooth”; NASB renders “Your words” and “sweet,” and adds “Yes, sweeter.”
Close to the Hebrew; “For my foot” is rendered “to my feet.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have turned” is rendered “I have inclined.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Half-hearted people” is rendered “those who are double-minded.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Let me be saved” is rendered “that I may be safe.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Their deceitfulness [is] falsehood” is rendered “their deceitfulness is useless.”
The Hebrew says “[as] dross you remove all the wicked”; NASB adds “like.”
